tools.name: postcode_lookup
tools.description: Get detailed data for one UK postcode. Case and spacing are ignored. Returns 404 if not found; the response has a terminated property if the postcode was previously active.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: UK postcode to look up, with or without spaces, e.g. 'SW1A 1AA'.

tools.name: bulk_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Bulk request for up to 100 postcodes in one call. Postcodes not found get a null result. Both postcodes and geolocations must be provided. For a single postcode use postcode_lookup.

parameters.name: postcodes
parameters.description: Array of up to 100 postcode strings.

parameters.name: geolocations
parameters.description: Array of up to 100 objects, each with longitude and latitude.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Comma-separated attributes to include in each result object, e.g. 'postcode,longitude,latitude'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum postcodes returned per location; must be less than 100. Default 10.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres; must be less than 2000. Default 100.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: If true, extends search radius up to 20km, returning at most 10 results.

tools.name: postcode_search
tools.description: Search postcodes by query string near a longitude/latitude. Each result includes a distance in metres from the given coordinates. widesearch extends to 20km (max 10 results, ignores radius and limit).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The search query string.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, WGS84 value between -180 and 180.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, WGS84 value between -90 and 90.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, max 100. Default 10.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000. Default 100.

parameters.name: widesearch
parameters.description: If true, wide area search up to 20km, at most 10 results.

tools.name: nearest_postcodes
tools.description: List postcodes nearest to a given postcode, ordered by distance. Returns 404 if the input postcode is not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The postcode to search from, e.g. 'AB10 1XG'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum postcodes to return, max 100. Default 10.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 2000. Default 100.

tools.name: postcode_autocomplete
tools.description: Complete a partial postcode: returns postcodes matching the given prefix.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Partial postcode to match, e.g. 'SW1A'.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum matches, must be less than 100. Default 10.

tools.name: random_postcode
tools.description: Get a random postcode with all its data, optionally restricted to an outcode. An invalid outcode returns null.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Optional outcode to restrict to, e.g. 'CM8' or 'SW1'.

tools.name: outcode_lookup
tools.description: Get detailed information about a UK outward code (first half of a postcode). Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: UK outward code, case-insensitive, e.g. 'BR8'.

tools.name: nearest_outcodes
tools.description: Find nearest outcodes ordered by proximity, either to a given outcode (pass outcode) or to a coordinate (pass lon and lat). Results have the same shape as outcode lookup.

parameters.name: outcode
parameters.description: Outcode to find neighbours of, e.g. 'NW1'. Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude, WGS84 between -180 and 180. Use with lat.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude, WGS84 between -90 and 90. Use with lon.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum outcodes returned, max 100. Default 10.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in metres, max 25000. Default 5000.

tools.name: places
tools.description: GB places: pass code to fetch one place by OSGB code, pass q to search places by name (full-text, falling back to prefix; up to 100), or pass nothing for a random place with all its data.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: OSGB code of a place, e.g. 'osgb4000000074564391'. Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query matched against primary and secondary place names.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum search results, max 100. Default 10. Only used with q.

tools.name: terminated_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Look up a terminated (no longer in use) UK postcode. Case and spacing are ignored. Returns 404 if not found.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The terminated UK postcode, e.g. 'E1W1UU'.

tools.name: scottish_postcode_lookup
tools.description: Look up the Scottish Postcode Directory record for a Scottish postcode. Returns 404 if not in the SPD (a specific message appears if it exists only in ONSPD).

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: The Scottish postcode, e.g. 'AB101XG'.
